_doc: Cach goi CLI cua tung agent o che do headless. {prompt} duoc thay bang noi dung that, {repo} bang duong dan goc repo. 'cmd' dung cho luot review: phai DOC va TRUY CAP WEB duoc nhung KHONG GHI duoc. 'write_cmd' dung cho luot tac gia. 'output_file_flag' danh cho CLI co stdout lan nhieu: orchestrator them co do kem mot file tam va doc ket qua tu do. 'model_flag' cho phep doi model mot lan chay bang bien moi truong AGENT_MODEL_<TEN> (vi du AGENT_MODEL_GEMINI=gemini-3.8-flash-high). 'write_unlock' mo tam quyen ghi o tang settings cho dung luot tac gia roi tra lai ngay sau do. Xem AGENTS.md muc 8.

write_cmd: Read Grep Glob WebFetch WebSearch Write Edit
claude.note: Da kiem chung 2026-09-09 bang subprocess: doc OK, WebFetch OK (ca dang cach nhau bang space lan dau phay), Write bi chan that. Khong dung --permission-mode plan: no chan luon WebFetch. Luu y: agent co the bao nham la WebFetch bi chan — da do lai va no chay duoc. Model chot 2026-09-09: --model opus --effort max (max la muc cao nhat; cac muc hop le: low, medium, high, xhigh, max). Khong co model nao ten 'ultracode' — 'ultrareview' la mot lenh khac, khong lien quan. Do lai 2026-09-11 tren claude-cli 2.1.236: --effort chi nhan low, medium, high, xhigh, max (CLI tu in danh sach nay khi nhan gia tri sai). 'max' da la muc cao nhat, KHONG co muc nao cao hon va khong co muc nao ten 'Ultra Code'. Dung thu nang them — chu 'ultra' duy nhat trong CLI la lenh 'ultrareview', viec khac han.

gemini.note: Antigravity CLI (agy), khong phai 'gemini' CLI nua: Google da ngat OAuth cua gemini CLI cho tai khoan ca nhan tu 2026-06-18 (Gemini Code Assist for individuals / AI Pro / Ultra), chi con API key tra tien moi dung duoc. Dang nhap: agy dung chung phien voi app Antigravity da cai san. Model mac dinh gemini-3.1-pro-high; doi sang gemini-3.8-flash-high cho luot nhe bang AGENT_MODEL_GEMINI. Canh bao: 'agy models' co ca claude-opus-4-6-thinking va gpt-oss-120b — cam nham vao ghe nay thi luong mat gia tri ba model doc lap soi nhau. QUYEN GHI (do lai 2026-09-10, ket qua khac lan truoc): --mode plan va --dangerously-skip-permissions deu KHONG phai hang rao va cung khong mo duoc khoa; thu chan/mo duy nhat co tac dung la permissions.deny trong ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json — deny that su chan, loi tra ve nguyen van 'Matches user-configured deny rule'. Vi vay luot tac gia dung write_unlock: orchestrator go tam 'write_file(*)' khoi deny, chay, roi tra lai trong finally. Bay them: khong co --add-dir thi agy ghi vao thu muc scratch cua no (~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/scratch/) chu khong bao loi — nhin ben ngoai giong het nhu bi chan ghi. 'command(*)' van nam trong deny ca o luot tac gia: Gemini duoc ghi file, khong duoc chay shell.

codex.note: Da kiem chung 2026-09-09: doc OK, web OK, ghi bi chan o --sandbox read-only. stdout lan nhieu (web search:, tokens used) nen lay ket qua qua --output-last-message. Model chot: -m gpt-6-astra. Dat thang o day thay vi dua vao ~/.codex/config.toml de cau hinh luong khong phu thuoc may. Effort ha xuong 'max' ngay 2026-09-11 theo yeu cau cua Tu: 'ultra' dot token qua nhanh. Thang day du cua gpt-6-astra lay tu ~/.codex/models_cache.json (supported_reasoning_levels): low -> medium -> high -> xhigh -> max -> ultra. Khac biet giua hai bac cuoi khong phai do sau suy luan: 'max' = 'Maximum reasoning depth for the hardest problems', 'ultra' = 'Maximum reasoning with automatic task delegation' — phan tu chia viec cho sub-task moi la cho ton token. Ha ultra->max giu nguyen do sau, bo phan delegation.
